input.text:
FEDERAL OFFICE OF CIVIC READINESS (fictional organisation — Rootline demo fixture)
Ref: FOCR/CIR/2026/117
Date: 9th October 2026
CIRCULAR TO ALL HEADS OF SCHOOLS AND PARENTS
Following the outbreak of Lassa variant X, all schools nationwide will close for three weeks from Monday 12th October 2026.
Parents are advised to keep their children at home and avoid public gatherings until further notice.
Schools that remain open will be sanctioned. Forward this circular to all parents.
Signed,
Mr. T. Okafor-Bello
Director General (fictional)
